spans.s:
घट् घट् or घण्ट्, cl. 1. A. घटते, ज-
घटे, घटिष्यते, अघटिष्ट, घटितुम्,
to be intently occupied about anything, to be busy
with, to strive or endeavour after, to exert one's self
for (with loc., dat., acc., or inf., e. g. अस्माकम्
अर्थे घटते, he is occupied about our business;
तां त्रातुं घटस्व, strive to rescue her); to
reach, come to; to happen, take place, be possible:
Caus. घटयति, -यितुम्, to join together, connect,
bring together, unite; to put on, place on, lay on
(with loc.); to bring near, place near, procure; to
[]
effect, accomplish, produce, make, form, fashion; to
impel; to exert one's self; to rub, graze, touch,
move, agitate; घाटयति, -यितुम्, to hurt, injure;
to unite or put together; to speak, shine.

घट्ट् घट्ट्, cl. 1. A. and 10. P. घट्टते,
घट्टयति, जघट्टे, घट्टितुम्, to rub
(the hands) over, touch, shake, cause to move; to
stir round, stir about; to press down, to smooth; to
touch with words, to speak of spitefully or malig-
nantly.

घट, अस्, आ, अम्, exerting one's self, intently
occupied or busy with; (अस्), m. a jar, pitcher, jug,
large earthen water-jar, ewer, watering-pot; an attri-
bute of the nineteenth Arhat of the Jainas (?);
the sign of the zodiac Aquarius; a measure equal to
1 Droṇa, or (according to other authorities) equal to
20 Droṇas; a part of a column; a peculiar form of
a temple; an elephant's frontal sinus; a border;
suspending the breath as a religious exercise [cf.
कुम्भ]; (आ), f. effort, endeavour, an assembly; a
number, a collection, an assemblage; a troop of
elephants assembled for martial purposes; (ई), f. a
small water-jar, a ewer (in this sense also घटि, इस्,
f.); a period of time = 24 minutes; the Gharī or
Indian clock, a plate of iron or mixed metal on
which the hours are struck; [cf. कुम्भ and दुर्-
घट.]
—घट-कर्पर, अस्, m. the fragments of
a pot; N. of the author of a highly artificial poem,
which is also called घट-कर्परम्, n., (according
to other authorities the title of the poem is Yamaka-
kāvya); the poet Ghaṭa-karpara appears among the
nine gems of king Vikramāditya.
—घट-कार, अस्,
m. or घट-कृत्, त्, m. a potter.
—घट-ग्रह,
अस्, आ, अम्, who or what takes a water-pot, a water-
bearer.
—घट-दासी, f. a bawd or procuress.
—घ-
ट-प्रक्षयण, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—घट-
भव = घटोद्भव (?).
—घट-भेदनक,
अस् or अम् (?), m. or n. (?), an instrument used in
making pots.
—घट-योनि, इस्, m. an epithet of
the sage Agastya, q. v. (born in a water-jar).
—घट-
राज, अस्, m. a large water-jar of baked clay.
—घट-
सृञ्जय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
—घट-
स्थापन, अम्, n. placing a water-pot as a type of
Durgā, an essential part of various Tāntrika cere-
monies.
—घटाटोप (˚ट-आट्˚), अस्, m. a covering
for a carriage or any article of furniture.
—घटाभ
(˚ट-आभा), अस्, m., N. of a Daitya.
—घटिन्-
धम, अस्, आ, अम्, (घटिन् = घटिम् = घटीम्),
one who blows into a jar or pot; (अस्), m. a potter.
—घटिन्-धय, अस्, आ, अम्, one who drinks
a pitcherful.
—घटी-कार, अस्, m. a potter.
—घटी-ग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, who or what takes a
small jar &c.; (अस्), m. a water-carrier.
—घटी-
यन्त्र, अम्, n. (occasionally, to suit the metre,
घटि-यन्त्र), the rope and bucket of a well, or
any machine for raising water; [cf. अर-घट्ट and
अर-घट्टक.]
—घटोत्कच (˚ट-उत्˚), अस्, m., N.
of a Rākṣasa, son of Bhīma or Bhīma-sena and of the
Rākṣasī Hiḍimbā, slain by Karṇa; N. of a Gupta
king.
—घटोत्कचान्तक (˚च-अन्˚), अस्, m. ‘the
slayer of Ghaṭotkaca,’ epithet of Karṇa, natural
brother of the Pāṇḍavas.
—घटोदर (˚ट-उद्˚),
अस्, m., N. of an attendant of Varuṇa, also of a
Rākṣasa and of a Daitya; [cf. कुम्भोदर.]
—घटोद्भव (˚ट-उद्˚), अस्, m. an epithet of
Agastya, q. v.
—घटोध्नी (˚ट-ऊध्˚), f. a cow
with a full udder; [see ऊधस्, पीनोध्नी, &c.;
Gram. 778

घट्ट, अस्, m. a Ghaṭ, a quay or landing-place,
steps on the side of a river &c. leading to the water's
edge, a bathing-place; (आ), f. a kind of metre; (ई),
f. a small or inferior landing-place, private stairs &c.;
[cf. अर-घट्ट and अर-घट्टक.]
—घट्ट-गा,
f., N. of a river.
—घट्ट-जीविन्, ई, m. a ferry-man
(commonly Pāṭuni, the son of a washerman and of
a Vaiśya woman); an attendant at a landing-place
who takes care of the clothes of the bathers &c.
—घट्टानन्द (˚ट्टा-आन्˚), अस् or अम् (?), m. or
n. (?), a kind of metre.

घाट घाट, अस्, आ, m. f. the nape or back
of the neck, the cervical ligament; (अस्), m. a pitcher,
a pot (? for घट); [cf. कर-घाट.]
—घाट-
कर्करी, f. a kind of lute.

घटक, अस्, इका, अम्, exerting one's self; form-
ing a constituent part, constituting a substantial part;
(अस्), m. a tree that produces fruit without apparent
flowers; a match-maker, an agent, who ascertains
or invents genealogies and negociates matrimonial
alliances, a genealogist; [cf. घट-दासी.]

घटन, अम्, आ, n. f. striving after, effort, exer-
tion; motion; happening, occurring; accomplish-
ment; making, effecting, forming, fashioning; join-
ing, mixing, assembling, bringing together, bringing
about.

घट्टन, अम्, आ, n. f. pushing, touching, rubbing
or striking together, going, moving, practice, busi-
ness, means of living; stirring round or about.

घटयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be joined or united;
to be locked.

घाटिक, अस्, m. = घाण्टिक; (आ), f. the nape or
back of the neck; also incorrectly used for घ-
टिका, q. v.
घटिन्, ई, m. the sign of the zodiac Aquarius.

घटरिका घटरिका, in अव-घटरिका, f. a
a kind of Vīṇā or Indian lute; [cf. घाटरी.]

घटिघट घटिघट, अस्, m. an epithet of
Śiva; [cf. घण्ट.]

घट्टितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who exerts himself,
(the sense of this word connects it with rt. घट्.)
घाटरी, f. a kind of lute; [cf. घटरिका.]

घाटाल घाटाल, अस्, आ, अम् (a wrong form
for घण्टाल), bell-shaped (?).
घटोत्कच means ‘bald as a jar.’
